description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific upgrade procedures, such as checking images, performing upgrades, and copying configurations for specific hardware boards within the OpenWRT project.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function to check the firmware image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a device-specific upgrade process based on the board name, invoking either emmc_do_upgrade or default_do_upgrade.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration if the board matches specific hardware.
